notes: Classic Era community-standard builds. Frost is the raid spec while Molten Core and Blackwing Lair are full of fire-immune targets; Fire overtakes it from AQ40/Naxxramas. One mage per raid runs the Winter's Chill support build. Allocations validated against the Classic tree data.

builds.name: Frost — Arcane Power / Frostbolt (raid DPS)
builds.summary: Highest personal Frostbolt damage in Classic: Arcane Power + Presence of Mind + Arcane Instability from a 31-point Arcane tree, with 20 points in Frost for Improved Frostbolt, Ice Shards, Piercing Ice, Elemental Precision and Frost Channeling. The build to run while fire-immune bosses dominate (MC/BWL).

core.why: +30% spell damage for 15s every 3 minutes; stacks with trinkets for huge burst windows.
Instant Frostbolt; combined with Arcane Power for burst.
-0.5s cast time on the only spell you cast.
+6% hit for Frost/Fire — the most valuable points in the tree.
Clearcasting procs = free Frostbolts and better mana.

flex.why: Pure filler to reach the tier requirements in Arcane.
Twentieth Frost point; Cold Snap is nice for Ice Block if you have it (you don't here), so Arctic Reach is a fair alternative.

notes: Frostbolt spam; Arcane Power + Presence of Mind + trinkets on the pull or during burn phases.
No Ice Block or Ice Barrier — this is a pure damage build.

builds.name: Frost — Winter's Chill (raid support)
builds.summary: One mage per raid runs this: Winter's Chill stacks +10% Frost crit on the boss for every other mage. It also brings Ice Block, Ice Barrier and Shatter, so it is the safest build for progression. Personal damage is a little below the Arcane Power build.

core.why: Stacking +2% Frost crit debuff (to 10%) for the whole raid's frost mages.
+100% Frostbolt crit damage — with Winter's Chill up you crit often.
+50% crit on Frozen targets — dungeons and AoE packs.

flex.why: Reach Arcane Meditation any way you like.
Improved Frost Nova is the prerequisite for Shatter.

notes: Standard 17/0/34; Wowhead/Icy Veins list minor variants (Arctic Reach, Improved Blizzard for AoE farming).

builds.name: Fire (raid DPS, AQ40 / Naxxramas)
builds.summary: Once fire-immune bosses are behind you, Fire is the top damage: Ignite (40% of crit damage as a rolling DoT, shared across all fire mages), Improved Scorch (+15% fire damage taken), Critical Mass, Fire Power and Combustion. Arcane still supplies Clearcasting and Arcane Meditation; Elemental Precision is taken from Frost for hit.

core.why: Crits add a DoT worth 40% of the crit; with several fire mages the Ignite stack is the biggest damage source in the raid.
+15% Fire damage taken on the boss; one mage maintains it.
Guaranteed crits until three land — the burst cooldown.
-20% Fire threat and pushback resistance — fire mages pull threat.

flex.why: Tier-1 Arcane filler; Arcane Focus only helps Arcane Explosion here.
Tier-2/3 Fire filler to unlock Improved Scorch and Master of Elements.
Trade mana regen against threat/AoE as gear improves.

notes: Scorch x5 to apply Improved Scorch, then Fireball; keep Fire Blast on cooldown only if movement forces it.
Not usable in Molten Core; most of Blackwing Lair is fire-resistant as well.

builds.name: Frost (PvP)
builds.summary: The standard Classic PvP mage: Shatter combos, Ice Block, Ice Barrier, Improved Cone of Cold, Permafrost, Cold Snap and Improved Counterspell, with Arcane taken to Arcane Meditation for regen.

core.why: +50% crit against Frozen targets: Frost Nova -> Frostbolt/Cone of Cold crits.
+35% Cone of Cold damage — the Shatter finisher.
+20% range on Frostbolt/Blizzard and Frost Nova/Cone of Cold radius.

flex.why: Flat damage vs. random freeze procs.

flex.default: Improved Arcane Explosion 3 + Magic Attunement 2 + Arcane Meditation 1
flex.why: Filler on the way to Improved Counterspell.

notes: Some PvP mages prefer 0/0/51-style deep frost or the PoM/Pyro (Arcane/Fire) burst build; this is the all-round choice.

builds.name: AoE grinding — Frost (Improved Blizzard)
builds.summary: The community AoE-farming build (Icy Veins' 1-60 AoE grinding build): control first — Elemental Precision so nothing resists, Improved Frost Nova, Permafrost and Improved Blizzard so a pack stays snared through two Blizzards, Cold Snap/Ice Block/Ice Barrier for bad pulls and for gathering — then damage (Piercing Ice, Ice Shards, Improved Cone of Cold) and Arcane mana talents. No Frostbite (freezes scatter the clump) and no Shatter (mobs are only frozen during the Nova, and the points buy more control elsewhere). Warcraft Tavern's 7/0/44 variant spends the Arcane points in Frost instead.

core.why: The essential talent: Blizzard kills the pack while its snare keeps the pack off you.
Makes the Blizzard chill last long enough for the second Blizzard to land before it wears off.
Nova every 21s instead of 25s: a second Nova is up when the pack closes, and there is margin for a resist.
One resist in a pack of 8 means melee damage; hit is control here, not DPS.
Blizzard from further away (less melee damage) and a bigger Nova/Cone of Cold radius.
A second Nova and Ice Block when a pull goes wrong.
Gather on the mount without being dazed off it; an escape when running.
Cone of Cold is cast every pack when the mobs close.

flex.why: Fifth Arcane tier-1 point; Icy Veins takes two Arcane Focus, any tier-1 point works.

alternatives: 7/0/44 (Warcraft Tavern): Shatter and the remaining Frost talents instead of Arcane
flex.why: Arcane Concentration + Arcane Meditation cut drinking; the deep-Frost variant trades that for Shatter crits during the Nova window.

notes: Never take Frostbite in this build: random freezes scatter the clump and mobs drift out of Blizzard.
Warcraft Tavern's guide keeps Improved Blizzard at 2/3 so the Blizzard chill does not overwrite Cone of Cold's stronger snare; Icy Veins takes 3/3.

Loop: gather (mount / Ice Barrier / pull-and-Ice Block), Frost Nova, Blink to range, two Blizzards, Cone of Cold as they close, kite until Nova is back, repeat; Arcane Explosion / wand for the last slivers.

builds.name: AoE grinding — deep Frost 7/0/44 (Shatter + Winter's Chill)
builds.summary: Warcraft Tavern's AoE build, decoded from the guide's talent-calculator link (the prose names only a few talents): the same control core as the Icy Veins build (Improved Frost Nova, Permafrost, Improved Blizzard 2/3 so the Cone of Cold snare is not overwritten, Arctic Reach, Cold Snap, Ice Block, Ice Barrier, no Frostbite) but the Arcane mana points go into Frost instead: Shatter 5/5 for crits during the Nova window, Winter's Chill 5/5, Improved Frostbolt 5 as the tier-1 filler.

core.why: 2/3 on purpose: 'otherwise it will cancel out your snare from Cone of Cold'.
Crits on the Nova-frozen pack (the guide's link takes 5/5; Icy Veins' build does not take it).
'You will be using Cone of Cold rather frequently and the 35% increase in damage is very helpful.'
'One of the easiest ways to round up mobs' - run through them shielded until they are grouped for Frost Nova.

alternatives: Arcane Meditation 3 + Wand Specialization 2 (the Icy Veins split)
flex.why: Winter's Chill stacks slowly on a pack that dies in 30s; the Arcane split trades it for regen.

notes: Loop per the guide: Cone of Cold, Frost Nova, Blink to max range, two Blizzards, Cone of Cold again as they close, Nova and repeat.
Frostbite: 'Do NOT put points into this talent, as it will cause issues with being able to properly clump the mobs together.'

builds.name: Leveling — Frost
builds.summary: Frost from 10 to 60: Improved Frostbolt and Ice Shards early, Shatter at 30, Ice Block at 34, then Winter's Chill and Ice Barrier. Ends in the 17/0/34 Winter's Chill raid build so you can raid immediately.

core.why: Frost Nova -> crit at 30 makes every pull a kite.

flex.why: If you AoE-grind, take Improved Blizzard/Permafrost while leveling and respec into Winter's Chill at 60.

notes: Frostbolt -> Frost Nova -> Frostbolt/Cone of Cold; Blizzard kiting in open areas once you have Improved Blizzard (if taken).
